periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, tilted approximately 30 degrees toward the nasal midline relative to the vertical cranial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering where the bottom of the patch extends significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve profile along the posterior edge of the transverse shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad thickness at the lateral flanks, tapering slightly as it crosses the spinal midline.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the superior cranium, approximately 2.5 times the width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown tint on the dorsal and lateral torso fur, contrasting with the high-white cranial fur.
